general.summary: Eight months after implementing a ban on under-16s accessing social media services like TikTok, Australia finds its younger users are returning in droves, according to new data from Qustodio.

general.title: Lego posts record first-half revenue, CEO touts strong sales at high-end and value pricing
general.summary: Lego CEO Niels Christiansen told CNBC the company is seeing strong sales at both ends of the pricing spectrum.

general.title: India’s Gig Economy Is Leaving Its Women Behind, Study Finds
general.summary: India’s gig economy, which includes 10-minute food delivery and ride-hailing apps, is creating millions of jobs. Yet, women are largely missing from it, according to a new study.

general.title: German Economic Revival Gathers Pace as Business Optimism Jumps
general.summary: Germany’s economy grew quicker than initially thought in the second quarter, while a top gauge of the business outlook hit its highest level since before the Iran war, further evidence that a long-awaited revival is under way.

general.title: Lunar Founders Raise €8 Million for Auditing Startup Built on AI
general.summary: The founders of Danish digital bank Lunar have raised €8.2 million ($9.6 million) to start an artificial intelligence-powered audit firm, betting that AI can disrupt an industry still heavily reliant on manual work.

general.title: Chinese tech giant Tencent sees spending surge, defends potential 'superior' AI returns
general.summary: Tencent stock was down 26% so far in 2026 as the company faces intense competition in China in AI and investors grow jittery about its rising spending.

general.title: Shein targets $27 billion Hong Kong IPO — a fraction of its 2022 valuation
general.summary: Shein is planning to raise up to $13.86 billion in Hong Kong dollars ($1.77 billion) in its initial public offering, according to a filing on Monday.

general.title: This $372 Million Bond Shows How AI Debt Is Jolting Markets
general.summary: The AI-debt deluge is getting so extreme in major credit markets that a global borrower is turning to far-flung New Zealand to try to escape it, in its first overseas issuance there in almost a decade.

general.title: BOJ’s Price Gauge Stays Above 2% Amid Rate Hike Speculation
general.summary: A Bank of Japan measure of underlying inflation remained above the central bank’s 2% target, supporting widespread expectations of a September rate hike.

general.title: Prudent Czechs to Loosen Fiscal Rules for Debt-Financed Investment Push
general.summary: The Czech Republic is preparing to loosen its budget rules to boost spending, a move that critics say risks endangering the long-term stability of state finances in one of Europe’s most fiscally conservative states.

general.title: Xpeng shares sink as weak delivery forecast overshadows $6.3 billion robot unit valuation
general.summary: Xpeng shares slid after weak delivery guidance, even as its nascent robotics business secured a valuation nearly matching that of its core EV business.

general.title: Hungary Heads for Third Rate Cut With Inflation at Decade-Low
general.summary: Hungary’s central bank is poised to deliver its third consecutive interest rate cut after the inflation rate fell to the lowest level in a decade.

general.title: Could Robots Be K-pop's Next Stars?
general.summary: AI is transforming South Korea's entertainment industry, with one startup betting on physical AI in the race to create the superstars of the future. Galaxy Corporation sees robot idols as the next generation of K-pop celebrities. Bloomberg's Sohee Kim reports from Seoul. (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: RBA Judged Current Rate Allows Time, Ready to Act If Needed
general.summary: Australia’s central bank opted to keep its key rate unchanged on signs that elevated inflation was gradually easing and the labor market beginning to loosen, giving it scope to assess incoming data for any signs that upside risks might “crystallize.”

general.title: India’s New Stock Auction Avoids Major Hiccups on Monthly Expiry
general.summary: India’s new closing-auction system avoided major disruptions for derivatives traders Tuesday, easing concerns that the mechanism was not prepared to handle one of the busiest trading days of the month.

general.title: Tight-Budget Consumers Drive Philippine Companies to Shift Gears
general.summary: From switching ingredients to staggering price increases, Philippine companies are rethinking strategies to cover rising costs without losing customers squeezed by inflation and a weak peso.

general.title: Ireland Gets Fresh Warning About Overspending Its Tax Bounty
general.summary: Ireland’s government received yet another warning from its fiscal watchdog about not overspending when the economy is already strong as it risks stoking inflation.

general.title: Gold Steadies After Four-Day Gain as Traders Eye Treasury Moves
general.summary: Gold steadied after a four-day rally sparked by a surprise bond-market intervention that’s revived concerns over US fiscal policy and dollar weakness.
